summary: Rename the "In one position" toggle to "All chords in one position", in Chords and Triads only
detail: The View toggle reads "Across the neck" / "In one position". The second name only describes what those two views do: Chords and Triads are the ones that bring the whole progression with you into the position, so "All chords in one position" says what you get. Pentatonic, Scales and Roots draw one thing in a position rather than every chord, so they keep the plain "In one position" - the label has to follow the Fretboard mode rather than being fixed markup. The button lives in index.html's #viewGroup and would need its text set from updateFretUI, which already runs on every mode change. Nothing reads the label as data: the view keys off data-value="position", so this is text only. The phrase also appears across README.md, the index.html tooltips, comments in js/fretboard-view.js and test names in js/tests.js and js/tests-fretboard.js - check which of those name the control (may need rewording) and which describe the reading in prose (leave).
resolution: Done 2026-09-07. The label is set from updateFretUI rather than fixed in the markup, so it follows the Fretboard mode: "All chords in one position" in Chords and Triads, plain "In one position" in Roots, Pentatonic and Scales. Text only - the reading is still chosen by data-value="position", so nothing that selects it had to change. The View tooltip and the two README passages naming the control were reworded; the prose describing the reading was left alone. Checked at 1100px and at 375px: the longer label keeps the row on one line and does not overflow. Covered by a test over all five views.
